EmailTemplate.subject: [{{org_name}}] Your application has been withdrawn
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Subject: [{{{org_name}}}] Your application has been withdrawn
Hello {{{contact_first_name}}},
This confirms that the application for {{{org_name}}} has been withdrawn as of {{{withdrawal_date}}}.
No further action is needed. The work you’ve already put in isn’t lost — if circumstances change, you’re always welcome to submit a fresh application.
Portal: {{{portal_url}}}
If this withdrawal is unexpected, reply to this email and we’ll help sort it out.
Warm regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
[grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
